review_kind: Read-only manual prospective profile/actual v3 source review; no corpus semantic execution or implementation
aligned: All documents are full responses from actual accepted v3 preparation; four real synthetic stage/payload instances and duplicate GBNF hashes are separately represented. No easier string grammar.
Fourteen fixed scalar/encoding strata and explicit field/context mapping are independent of observed token merges;42cases are not falsely presented as a full three-field by three-context factorial.
Raw and ASCII-escaped forms remain distinct byte representations with paired identical decoded responses; UTF8/strictJSON/semantic/generation membership are separate dimensions.

Coverage population is predetermined expected eligibility, not observed native success; first(case,token) selection occurs after wholecorpus counts, multi-class selections de-duplicate and incomplete prefixes are not retokenized.
Mixed coverage requires an entire complete scalar interval within the same finalpiece before its pending scalar, excluding mere completion of a scalar started in a priorpiece.
Old189case profile stays failed; all unavailable classes, unknown counts, case mismatches and missingrecords veto this separate engineering experiment.

findings.finding: Unconditional token/piece arrays and concatenation==raw wording conflicts with six predeclared rawNUL/malformedUTF8 harness dispositions, whose native membership is null and which must not be tokenized.
findings.requested_contract: Define a typed null ledger and zero native token/piece/sampler calls for declared byte-harness ineligibility; retain exact bytes/hash/harness outcome and exclusion reason. Define known zero coverage for declared excluded cases separately from unknown coverage caused by unexpected QC failure. Unexpected failure cannot be converted into a favorable exclusion.

findings.finding: Full complete-width by pending-width matrix is required, but the counting unit for multiple contained scalars in one qualifying piece is not yet specified.
findings.requested_contract: Count each boundary once for each distinct complete scalar width wholly contained before the pending scalar; repeated scalars of one width do not multiply the cell. Retain contained-width set/representative interval evidence. Matrix sum can exceed mixed-boundary total when one boundary witnesses more than one width; state this explicitly.

expected_semantic_review_after_freeze: Independently use actual v3 raw-byte postvalidator with exact stage payload, not a repaired/reconstructed json.loads object, for all expected semantic outcomes.

For duplicate-name/lonesurrogate/rawnewline controls, distinguish reference JSON parseability from strict project parse success; null unavailable decoded-stage values rather than inserting a repaired stage response.

Raw-vs-ASCIIescape pair identity must include exact decoded fullresponse and matching target field, plus per-wire raw multibyte/width and escape statistics. ASCIIescape spellings are not raw multibyte witnesses.
Verify all84 case IDs, stage/grammar/payload bindings, byte caps/hashes and fixed mapping without token or model access.

conditional_cap_arithmetic_review.array_bound: 12N+3B+constant is conservative using at most six digits per vocabulary ID, sum(piece_lengths)=B, and hex payload2B; it is not three independent per-element worst cases.
conditional_cap_arithmetic_review.qualification_limit: Arithmetic is conditional on exact eventual schema fitting the reserved overhead and per-event caps. Source/row-size checks are still required; no runtime/resource-fit or all-possible-module-path guarantee.

preserved_native_limits: 117s cooperative/120s wholechild/300s owner/256MiB; no compiler, pack, native/controller/bridge implementation or execution authorized by review
